notes: Native messaging keeps one persistent stdin/stdout pair, preventing stream disposal and intermittent bridge failures
HTTP Origin and Cookie headers are combined into one FFmpeg header block for better compatibility
Quality probing uses ffprobe and returns resolution, codec, FPS, bitrate and stream index when available
FFmpeg recovery keeps conservative profiles and exposes the real rejected option/diagnostic instead of only the last error line
Automatic updater stages and verifies the extension before replacement, backs up native binaries, rolls back on failure, and cleans older backups
Windows now registers a per-user scheduled updater that checks for updates every 6 hours even when Chrome is closed
The extension also checks on Chrome startup and on its normal alarm schedule, with reload only after verified update completion
